provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study, not new experimental measurements.
provenance.scope: Results are conditional on the complete stated model, measurement convention and units.

model: Equal-depth gauges on one homogeneous isotropic plane-stress patch measure total strain epsilon(theta)=epsilon_xx*cos(theta)^2+epsilon_yy*sin(theta)^2+gamma_xy*sin(theta)*cos(theta)+alpha*DeltaT. Unknown epsilons are MECHANICAL strains, gamma_xy is ENGINEERING shear. The independent temperature observation fixes the common thermal term. No bending, gauge bias or temperature-dependent modulus.
reporting: The major principal axis is an unoriented axis. Report its angle in [-90,90) degrees from x; opposite eigenvector signs are identical. Yield screen passes at von Mises<=threshold. In the naive comparison set the thermal correction to zero but keep all measured readings and other inputs.
